**Public Notice – Track Possession TPN-2086**

**Issued by:** Public Notices Office
**Date of Issue:** 12 August 2026
**Notice Number:** TPN-2086

---

**1. Purpose of this Notice**

The Public Notices Office issued public notice TPN-2086. Record status: current. This notice is to advise passengers, local residents, businesses, and other stakeholders of an upcoming track possession on the Main South Line. During the possession, sections of track will be closed to rail traffic to allow essential maintenance and infrastructure renewal work to be carried out safely.

The work is part of the ongoing program to maintain the reliability and safety of the rail corridor. The possession has been planned to minimise disruption to the community, and this notice provides details of the affected sections, the type of work involved, and the alternative travel arrangements that will be in place.

---

**2. Description of the Work**

The following maintenance activities will be undertaken during the possession:

- **Resurfacing and ballast tamping** on a 14-kilometre section of track between the township of Berrigan and the Merriwa Creek bridge.
- **Renewal of timber sleepers** at three identified locations where timber sleepers have reached the end of their serviceable life.
- **Replacement of a turnout** at the Berrigan North junction, including the associated point operating equipment.
- **Correction of track geometry** and re-railing on the curved section approaching the Merriwa Creek bridge.
- **Inspection and maintenance of drainage culverts** along the affected corridor.

All work will be carried out by qualified rail infrastructure crews. The possession has been planned to allow the work to be completed in a single continuous window, reducing the number of occasions the line is closed.

---

**3. Affected Sections of the Rail Line**

The possession applies to the following sections of the Main South Line:

- **Berrigan to Merriwa Creek bridge** – single track section, approximately 14 kilometres in length.
- **Berrigan North junction** – including the turnout and associated track work within the junction limits.
- **Merriwa Creek bridge approaches** – the track on both sides of the bridge structure.

The affected corridor is located between the Berrigan station (kilometre 412) and the Merriwa Creek bridge (kilometre 426).

No other sections of the Main South Line are affected by this possession. Services operating north of Berrigan and south of the Merriwa Creek bridge will continue to run to their normal timetables, except where noted in Section 5 below.

---

**4. Affected Services and Travel Times**

During the possession, rail services will be altered on the affected sections. The following services will be affected:

- **Passenger services** operating through the Berrigan to Merriwa Creek section will be replaced by road coaches for the duration of the possession.
- **Freight services** scheduled to operate through the affected section will be re-routed or rescheduled. Some freight trains may be subject to extended transit times.

Passengers are advised to check the journey planner or contact their train operator for the most up-to-date information on their specific service.

---

**5. Alternative Transport Arrangements**

To maintain connectivity for passengers during the possession, the following alternative arrangements will be in place:

Passengers are advised to allow additional travel time during the possession period, as road coach replacement services may take longer than the normal rail service.
